  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  April 11, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on April 11, 2024 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt.Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Kenrick Sanderlin / Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Jazmine Covington, Emergency Services / Public Safety

  Staff Present:  Angela Allen, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance department
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on March 28, 2024

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Teresa Estrada on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a 3rd Annual Inglewood STEM Fest
  Event at 700 Warren Ln., Edward Vincent Jr- Champions Field, Public Property,on
  Saturday, April 20, 2024, from 9:30 a.m – 1:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Applicant to adhere to all
  recommendations outlined by the IPD / Planning Department Department; Applicant
  Approved for one (1) day event.; Applicant to hire two (2) Inglewood Police Officers; two
  (2) City Hall Security Guards Security Guards for the safety of attendees and employees;
  All Security Guards / Event Staff shall wear reflective vests; A Watch Commander will be
  notified, Extra Patrol will be provided as time permits; Maintain site at all times, ensuring
  site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members
  working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face
  mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State
  health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00384279)
